descriptionChirho: To make an earnest request or entreaty, either to ask for something or to beg that something not happen (Mk 15:6; Heb 12:19).
To ask to be excused from an obligation or invitation, offering reasons for declining (Lk 14:18-19).
To decline, turn away from, or reject something or someone, often a command, teaching, or person (1 Tim 4:7; 5:11; 2 Tim 2:23; Tit 3:10; Acts 25:11; Heb 12:25).
